# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [US pushed Venezuela and Iraq to weigh leaving OPEC, Reuters reports, days before OPEC+ meets](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 28, 2026. Washington has been nudging two of OPEC's founders toward the door. Reuters, citing 10 people, reports the US encouraged Venezuela and Iraq this year to consider leaving the group and blocked Venezuela's dues.
- [Midstream: Trans Mountain finishes its flow boost early as quarterly shipments rise](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Downstream: Projectile strike at Aramco's Jazan refinery kills a worker and halts some units](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Regulation: FERC approves Sabine Pass expansion and four more gas projects](https://uticamidstream.com/#ferc)
- [Cross-industry: Brent posts first weekly gain of November as Gulf attacks continue](https://uticamidstream.com/#weekly)
